framework_notes: The supplied implementation is plain static HTML with CSS and JavaScript assets, not a React, Next.js, Vue, or Svelte route.
No build tool, package manager, or TypeScript execution pipeline is evidenced.
The static_markdown adapter is available but reports index_shell_supported=false and detail_shell_supported=false; availability does not establish that it can rewrite this HTML shell.
Frontmatter requires an explicit generation step to produce deployable HTML; raw frontmatter is not a browser rendering mechanism.
Existing story cards, featured presentation, images, and introduction can be preserved without generating replacement components.

acceptance_criteria: Article records have stable, unique identifiers and valid destinations.
The registry contains metadata rather than eagerly imported article bodies.
actions: Check the repository for an existing article metadata source before creating a duplicate.
If none exists, create a metadata-only registry covering the 35 grid entries and the featured article.
Preserve titles, descriptions, dates, categories, images, and actual destination paths from the existing HTML.
Implement the ArticleRecord contract using verified detail-page or content metadata; do not invent authors, content paths, modification dates, editorial data, or download records.
Represent unavailable fields according to an explicitly defined schema policy.

acceptance_criteria: Registry changes are reflected in published listing HTML.
The directory remains readable and navigable without client-side JavaScript.
No unconfigured TypeScript or frontmatter runtime dependency is introduced.
actions: Define an offline generation or setup step that consumes the registry and updates the existing featured section and story grid.
Use an HTML-capable adapter or an explicit route patch because the supplied adapter does not support index-shell generation.
Preserve the existing hero, site chrome, footer, SEO tags, CSS classes, and standard HTML anchors.
Do not replace the already implemented directory container, heading, list, or links with redundant components.

acceptance_criteria: Each generated listing page respects the configured page-size policy.
actions: Generate static pagination with the configured page size of 24 when adopting the scale policy.
Keep featured placement explicit and avoid unintended duplication.
Define canonical URLs for additional listing pages and verify navigation between them.
patch_plan.work: Apply the planned listing scale policy
